newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose sharply to 2.825 billion yuan from 1.142 billion yuan with the 30-day contract the most active.
Traders said trading was more active on Tuesday because of a rise on the domestic A share markets and the issue of A shares by Jiamusi Papermaking Co Ltd on the Shenzhen stock exchange.
"Securities houses borrowed more money from the short-term financial centres due to activities on the A share markets," said one trader.
The centres are money brokerages run by the central bank.
State banks mainly stayed on the sidelines, traders said.
Traders said the interbank rates were likely to continue to be affected by the performance of the A share markets in the short term. -- Shanghai newsroom (86-21) 6279-7004
